name: Charlie Dean
title: Sexual Health Psychologist
practice: SHIPS Psychology (Sexual Health and Intimacy Psychological Services)
description: Charlie has extensive experience in providing LGBTIQA+, kink-specific, and nonmonogamy and polyamory support, as well as sexual education. Charlie has been a sex educator for several years and completed their Master's thesis on sex and gender-diverse individuals in the polyamorous community. Charlie is a neuro-affirming, kink-inclusive, and sex work-positive practitioner. Treatment areas include gender questioning support, childhood sexual trauma, long term/complex trauma.
specialties: LGBTIQA+ support, kink-specific support, poly/non-monogamy, sex work support, gender questioning, PTSD, sexual trauma, complex trauma, sexual health

name: Thanh Nguyen
title: Sexual Health Clinician (Accredited Mental Health Social Worker)
practice: SHIPS Psychology (Sexual Health and Intimacy Psychological Services)
description: Her approach is compassionate, collaborative and trauma-informed. Treatment areas include post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), childhood sexual trauma, adult sexual trauma, long term/complex trauma, recent trauma and relational/attachment trauma.
specialties: trauma, PTSD, sexual trauma, complex trauma, anxiety, depression, grief, substance use

name: Lauren French
title: Sexual Health Clinician (Sexologist)
practice: SHIPS Psychology (Sexual Health and Intimacy Psychological Services)
description: Her approach is always warm and empathetic, with curiosity used to safely dive into the tensions held around sex and sexuality. Inclusivity is a crucial element of Lauren's work, and as a bisexual woman of colour, she welcomes all people to work with her. Treatment areas include pleasure-focused coaching and sexual health, wellbeing, and sexuality education.
specialties: sexuality, sex education, pleasure-focused coaching, desire and intimacy
identity: proud Karajarri woman; bisexual woman of colour
